No QueryableCreator references found in the Grafana codebase. However, if Grafana uses Thanos query gRPC API (via querypb), the protobuf interface would remain unchanged, so Grafana is not directly affected by this Go type signature change.

mimir.reason: Mimir does not directly import github.com/thanos-io/thanos/pkg/query. Mimir has its own querier implementation in pkg/querier/. While Mimir historically derived from Thanos/Cortex, it has diverged and maintains its own query path. No QueryableCreator references found in the Mimir codebase. Mimir interacts with storage backends directly, not through Thanos QueryableCreator.
